# Preface {.unnumbered}

This is an open online book on perception: how robots, from tiny drones to autonomous vehicles, turn light and other signals into an understanding of the world around them.

It is written for students meeting computer vision and robot perception for the first time, and it is built to be used, not just read. Many chapters contain:

- **Live demos** that run OpenCV on your own webcam, directly in the browser. Video is processed on your device and never uploaded.
- **Editable code** you can change and run in the page, with no installation.

::: {.callout-note}
## Work in progress
The book is being written. Chapters will appear here as they are ready.
:::

## About the author {.unnumbered}
